units.source_text: 我在寻思：为什么雪不给巴？

en.t: I was wondering: why does snow not stammer?

units.source_text: 在被八角金盘的叶子阻挡的时候，雪也会结结巴巴似地降落在地面上。

en.t: When it is obstructed by the leaves of the Japanese aralia, the snow too falls to the ground as if stammering.

units.source_text: 我沐浴在从毫无阻隔的天空纷扬而降的雪中，就忘却心灵的扭曲，

en.t: Bathed in the snow fluttering down from an utterly unobstructed sky, I forgot the distortions of my heart,

units.source_text: 好像沉浸在音乐中，我的精神恢复了工整的旋律。

en.t: and, as though immersed in music, my spirit recovered an orderly melody.
